question.text: Among <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Co</mi><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>Ti</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Cr</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> ions, one if used as a reagent cannot liberate <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> from dilute mineral acid solution, its spin-only magnetic moment in gaseous state is _____  B.M. (Nearest integer)

solution.text:
Among the given species Co3+ cannot undergo oxidation, hence, Co3+ can't liberate H2.

It has d6 configuration,

Number of unpaired electrons =4

μ=nn+2B.Mμ=4×6=4.92 B.M.
